children.value: Here’s what our teaching approach is built on:
No tedious drilling. Unlike many typing tutors, KeyLearn never makes you repeat the same block like ‘
’ over and over. That gets tiresome fast and barely helps you learn.

Instead, an algorithm builds lessons that match your current skill level. Each lesson is made of random words drawn from a subset of your alphabet’s letters. The algorithm decides how large that subset is and how often each letter shows up, aiming to give you the most effective learning experience.

Letters quietly fade if you leave them alone

Skills rust when they go unused, and KeyLearn reflects that honestly. A key you haven't practiced in a long time slowly loses a little confidence over real time, so you might see an old letter drift back from green toward red on its own. That's not you getting worse — it's the app gently flagging that the letter is due for a refresh before it truly slips. Your best-ever result for a key is never wiped out; only the current reading softens.

children.value: At the start, words are generated from just a handful of the alphabet’s most common letters.

As you type those words, the app tracks a time-to-type measurement for each letter in the subset. That measurement is how your progress gets tracked — the more comfortable you get with a letter, the faster you type it.
Once you’re comfortable with the whole current subset, the algorithm grows it by folding in additional letters.

children.value: Når du begynner å skrive de genererte ordene, samler datamaskinen inn statistikk over dine skriveferdigheter. Indikatorene begynner å skifte farger fra rød til grønn. Fargen rød betyr at skrivehastigheten for den aktuelle bokstaven er treg, og fargen grønn indikerer det motsatte. På dette stadiet er målet ditt å gjøre alle bokstavene grønne ved å forbedre skrivehastigheten. Vær oppmerksom på at i dette eksemplet er bokstaven ‘

’ fremhevet, ettersom den har den laveste skrivehastighetsmålingen, og derfor blir den målbokstaven. Målbokstaven er inkludert i hvert generert ord, og dette er en viktig informasjon å vite. Det betyr at til enhver tid øver du på nøyaktig den bokstaven som gir deg mest problemer.
